communication_goal: 区分功能可运行和界面可用，补齐交互反馈。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The stick-figure programmer sits left and points toward a large upright smartphone standing on a small desk near center-right, with the white OpenAI knot floating above and to its right. The entire PHONE body and rounded screen are clearly visible. Its UI uses only blank boxes, a simple spinner ring and a small check symbol, no letters or digits. Keep the phone large and easy to crop.

coverage_review.scope: V021 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/V021.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：黑底白线单幅场景，一个火柴人与一个可辨认 OpenAI 六环结 Logo；命名道具清楚可见，底图无对白文字。逐词框仅标注真实指代对象；抽象过程以四话轮对白作证据。
